title: AllergenProfile
description: Probability that an entity carries each allergen unit. Bins: set by orders (profiling). Tools, hands, plates: clean at shift start, then updated by the partner graph.

probabilities.description: Allergen unit ID -> probability. Units not listed are 0, unless unknown is true.

unknown.description: True when the entity's history is unknown (appeared mid-shift, re-acquired track). Treated as possibly carrying every allergen (invariant 8).

unclear_ingredients.description: Ingredients Jev could not place; each needs a one-time chef confirmation.
